booking.pick_service_lead: Pick the kind of meeting you need, then a time that suits you. It is free and takes a minute.
booking.no_public_types: Online booking is not available right now
booking.no_public_types_text: Send us your details instead and a counsellor will call you to agree a time.
booking.no_slots_week_text: Try the next week, or request a call back.
booking.free_cancel: You can reschedule or cancel from the link in your confirmation e-mail.
booking.booked_text: We sent a confirmation with this link. Keep it to reschedule or cancel.
booking.link_later: Your counsellor will share the link before the meeting.
booking.private_link: This page is private. Anyone with the link can view and change this booking — do not share it.
booking.agenda_lead: Consultations for the selected period. Times shown in your time zone.
booking.none_text: Bookings from the website, the portal and your team appear here.
booking.no_types_text: Create an appointment type and choose which counsellors take it.
booking.no_staff_for_type: No counsellor takes this appointment type yet. Add counsellors in the appointment type settings.
booking.no_slots_day: No free times on this day. Check the counsellors’ availability or pick another day.
booking.meeting_url_hint: Google Meet, Teams or Zoom link. Sent to the student in the reminder.
booking.availability_lead: Weekly hours people can book you, in {tz}. Leave a day empty when you are not available.
booking.no_types_for_employee: This person is not assigned to any appointment type, so nobody can book them yet.
booking.hours_hint: Add a second range on a day for split hours (e.g. a lunch break).
booking.time_off_hint: Leave the times empty for a full day off, or enter special hours for that date.
booking.staff_hint: Only these people can be booked for this type.
booking.ticket_code_ph: Scan the QR code or paste the ticket link
booking.branch_hint: Branch staff (e.g. the branch manager) can see the registrants. Leave empty for a company-wide course or event — then only the instructor / organiser and company-wide roles see them.
booking.organizer_hint: The organiser always sees and manages the registrants.

courses.waitlisted: You are on the waiting list.
courses.registered_text: We sent the details to you. Keep this page’s link to manage your registration.
courses.payment_note: Payment instructions will be sent by the GEC team. Your seat is confirmed once payment is received.
courses.cert_not_found_text: No certificate with the number {no} was issued by GEC.
